== Notes ==
* The second and third life steal effects occur 1 and 2 seconds (respectively) after spell activation.
* Casting requires a target which must be in spell range.  The second affected foe must be in the area of the target. The third affected foe must be in the area of the second affected foe. 
{{anomaly|The hits of this spell don't have an animation, unlike [[Deathly Swarm]].}}
